issues.description: The problem statement requires a function/label named `print_newline`, but the solution defines a different label `print_nl` and neither template nor solution provide a `print_newline` symbol. This naming inconsistency makes it unclear what identifier students are expected to implement and would break grading if tests look for `print_newline`.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the required symbol name across all artifacts: either rename the solution label `print_nl:` to `print_newline:` (and add the same label to the template if students should implement it), or change the problem statement to require `print_nl` instead of `print_newline`.
